'''''NGC-1710''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], it was used to bring [[Nova Stihl]] from [[Despayre]] to [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]].
